limits: Standalone research bench, not installed museum-route verification.
Pointer events exercise real area-button wiring; no tracked hands or human headset test.
Ideal sphere rotational invariance is analytic; finite render mesh and lighting need visual interpretation.
These tests establish sample-and-hold behavior, not perceptual proof of a physical zoetrope illusion.

observations.ideal_sphere_limit: Radial distance is an analytic invariance test. The displayed SphereMesh is finite triangulation, so exact arbitrary-angle mesh symmetry is not claimed.
